_comment: SIH26038 Phase 5 — grading evaluation config. All settings, no magic numbers in Python. Raw softmax is NEVER called calibrated.

dataset.comment: APTOS 2019 via Kaggle mirror mariaherrerot/aptos2019 (train_1/valid/test CSVs + nested PNG dirs). Labels combined then re-split by the notebook procedure below; the mirror's own pre-split is NOT trusted.

split.comment: Exact notebook reconstruction (02[6]): 70/30 then 50/50 of temp, stratified, seed 42. test_df is the held-out set (built in notebooks, never evaluated there).

referable.comment: SIH binary task. Targets sensitivity>90% / specificity>85% are TARGETS, not claims.
referable.score_definition: P2+P3+P4 (sum of predicted probs for grades >= 2)

decision_threshold.comment: Default 0.5; grid analysis runs on VALIDATION only, frozen choice applied once to test.
